messages:
Maya Chen: Dropping a new compact tile for the latency grid. Main idea: p95 big, tiny throughput (RPS) sparkline + an inline 'Sampling' chip (top-right) that opens a small popover with mode + percent slider. Mock attached. Thoughts on labels, focus, and mobile? :wave: Ethan Gray: Clean. A couple things: 1) chip should explicitly show state like 'Sampling: Adaptive' or 'Sampling: 10%' so users see it without opening, 2) throughput needs unit label 'RPS' and hover tooltip with exact number, 3) mobile should collapse to p95-only. Priya Singh: Accessibility items: chip must be keyboard-focusable and include aria-expanded/aria-controls. Popover should be role="dialog" (contains sliders) and we should announce on open with a live region: "Sampling settings opened. Currently Adaptive at 10%." When slider changes, update a polite live region. Also include an sr-only definition: 'Sampling reduces plotted traces to improve signal and reduce rendering cost.' Nora Kim: Copy recs: use 'Sampling: Adaptive' (capitalized) on chip and title the popover 'Sampling settings'. For any estimated cost line prefix with 'Estimated' and add clarifier: 'For rendered traces only; not a billing statement.' I'd hide cost behind an opt-in toggle inside the popover to avoid confusion. Maya Chen: Good — will update mock. Interaction notes: shortcut 't' toggles timepicker; when chip popover opens focus goes to first control. ARIA snippet for frontend:
...
Ethan Gray: For keyboard nav in the timepicker: left/right moves small increments, Shift+left/right jumps larger. Add to shortcuts doc. Also prefer small numeric tooltip on sparkline hover for RPS. Priya Singh: Confirming SR behavior: live region announces open and slider changes. Also ensure focus ring is visible on chip. DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-warning on chip text at current token; recommend using text-strong token or +font-weight. Tag: design-accessibility. :robot_face: Maya Chen: I'll iterate the Figma with the chip state, aria snippet, opt-in cost toggle, and mobile collapse. Posting update later today. :raised_hands:
